This file exists because 'follow the prototype' was an instruction an agent could
quietly not follow, and one did: two screens shipped without the campaign rail the
mock draws beside every one of them, and nothing anywhere said so.
What belongs here is text that states identity or carries a rule — the screen code,
the page title, field labels in the prototype's bilingual 'ไทย · English (บังคับ)'
form, and the notes that explain a consequence. What does not belong here is copy
that only appears in an error or a demo state, and copy for a screen or control
that does not exist yet: a landmark nobody can satisfy stops being a measurement
and becomes a test everyone learns to skip.
This measures wording, not features. A screen can pass every landmark and still be
missing a search box the prototype draws. Each screen's `rejected` map says which
strings were left out and why, so the gaps stay written down instead of forgotten.
